subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers on the Japanese Press
subfiles.about: An index summarizes papers filed under 894.91 concerning Japanese newspapers, news agencies, propaganda, and government interference with the press between 1930 and 1934.
subfiles.summary: Lists a 1930 newspaper survey, press-affiliation reporting, the Japan Times/Mail takeover, a Rengo-Dempo merger plan, and press interference.

interest: Tracks 1930-34 reports on Japanese press ownership and propaganda.
